KiEu$YiWu#zckS()vB3f: The MMIC Sound Player
-- Welcome to the MMIC Sound Player! --
So, kaidun1112cubosh, you enjoying the Sound Player?
I hope so.
So, because you clicked the symbol, you should know what clicking it really gives you.
This is the place where I tell everyone what MMIC's mission is, and also have credits.
-- MMIC's Mission --
The MMIC Sound Player's mission is to give everyone a free way to listen to music.
With the MMIC Sound Player, you can import audio files, download and listen to them from the
cloud, and also listen to MMIC Live radio stations.
Yes, thats what 20MB of space gives you.
Secondly, I have taken the vow to the community to never, ever, monitize the MMIC Sound
player. It belongs to the people, being open source and auditable.
And if someone wants to pay me to monitze our project, I'll turn them down.
Yep. I will refuse money, real money, to stop the ads that has helped destroyed the internet
Everything is in the peoples hands.
And because this is indeed open source, anyone who can spend a lotta time can even mod
the MMIC Sound Player to add any feature or look you want.
You can also directly modify the files inside the Sound Player's .mmic file too. Its just a
renamed zip file.
-- How I made this --
You might also wonder, why did I have to wait so long to get here in the first place?
Loading times are cursed because was made in PenguinMod.
PenguinMod is a mod of Turbowarp, which is a mod of Scratch. Yes, the same website
at https://scratch.mit.edu.
I'd say its impressive that I pulled this off, and I think some people who know Scratch,
Turbowarp, or PenguinMod would agree.
And its the work of 30 extensions, 500 hours, a 2017 Chromebook, and a dream
And now, exactly 169 days later, we are at v1.1.8b6
-- Orgins --
This isn't my first attempt at makeing a music player. I first made one on Scratch
years ago, Same name, same vibe, and some of the same stuff as here
Wanna know why space ends songs? That project is why (space was easy to use)
Wanna know why this isn't 1.0.0? That project is also why (it was v1.1.7)
I took a lot of thinks from that old project over here.
The side button bar was taken, the version thing was taken, the sidebar on the home
screen was taken, the RGB button was taken, and I could go on for 2 more hours
-- Who Helped --
I cannot name everyone, but I'll name the most important people who made a impact
Sharkpool, you really helped with your great extenstions. I have like ten of them here.
MikeDev101, I really love your CloudLink V4 extenstion. Its really good and I use it for the
IndexServer. Without it, this may have been impossable
JloAu, I liked your ScratchOS 3.0 to use some of it, I did take the cool a** intro you made
TheShovel, your debugger is the best I've found in a while. I really like the CLI it has
and its color code (Press control-shift-backspace or insert)
Gen1x, your Storage+ extenstion is the one thing holding the stack together. Its
IndexedDB storage mode powers MediaCentre. Without it, no offline would have existed
LilyMakesThings, your TurboWarp Skins extenstion is the only way for me to power
the media player with imagry. If I never had that extension, then that cover you see
wouldn't be there in MediaCentre
-- Final Notes --
kaidun1112cubosh
I gotta thank you for reading this far. I don't anyone really wanted to read this
Oh, and yes, this list knows your username. I coded it that way.
And with that bye!

A}.text:
My customizable progress bar has many features ! Here are the features :

• Start • 0 to 360 • The angle of the beginning (0 is on the top)
• Direction • 1 or -1 • The direction of rotation of the circle (1 is clockwise, -1 is counterclockwise) • The default value is 1.
• Quality • 1 to 360 •The number of segments that make up the whole circle (low value = + performance + possibility to make polygons) (24 is the default value)
• Progress • 0 to 100 • The percentage of progress (if the value is > 100 or < 0 the progress bar will not be displayed)
• Color • Tint (0 - 100) • Saturation (0 -100) • Brightness (0 -100) • The color of the cicular progress bar
• Thickness • Thickness of the circular progress bar
• Position • X • Y • Position of the center of the circle
• Radius • Radius of the circular progress bar

• Dotted? • true/false • If true the circular progress bar is made with dots
• Background? • true/false • If true a backgound will be displayed under the circular progress bar with these following settings:

• BG Color • Tint (0 - 100) • Saturation (0 -100) • Brightness (0 -100) • The color of the Background
• BG Thickness • Thickness of the Background
